what: Expedia Group runs online travel booking. It owns Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo for holiday rentals, plus a large business-to-business arm that powers travel booking for airlines, banks and other companies.
customers: Travellers booking hotels, flights and rentals, hotels and property owners listing with it, and corporate partners using its booking technology.
moat: Hotel supply relationships built over decades and a business-to-business platform that is hard to replicate, since partners embed it deeply in their own products.
risks: Booking Holdings is larger and more profitable in Europe
Google captures travel demand before it reaches booking sites
Vrbo has lost ground to Airbnb
Travel demand falls in a recession
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 20% with cash roughly matching debt
Analysts see about 36% upside from current levels
The business-to-business arm grows faster and needs no marketing spending
watch: Gross bookings growth and business-to-business revenue share.
